{{Quote|Excuse me fine sir, but do you by any chance have jogan fruit?|C-3PO talking to the Ithorian|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
An '''[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]''' visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] briefly spoke with this Ithorian, asking him if by any chance he had any [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]] for sale, to which the Ithorian responded by pushing C-3PO aside and walking away.
